subject: Trading
title: Confirmation Bias on Charts
description: A fast breakdown of Confirmation Bias on Charts for builders.

hook.text: You want the stock to go up, so you see a bullish pattern on the chart. But is it really there?

buildup.text: Confirmation bias makes traders see patterns that confirm their existing position or belief.

discovery.text: Studies show traders interpret ambiguous chart patterns as bullish when they're long and bearish when short.

twist.text: Even experienced analysts disagree on the same chart. Subjectivity is baked into pattern recognition.

climax.text: The antidote: always ask 'What would make me wrong?' before committing to a pattern-based trade.

punchline.text: You don't see the chart. You see your bias.

quiz.question: What is confirmation bias in chart analysis?
options: Seeing patterns that confirm your existing belief or position
